## Requirements: Pages Phase 2-B2 — GitHub-sourced Issue to PR references

Incremental Phase 2-B2 of #1782: add an exact **GitHub Issue Timeline → PR cross-reference** edge to the independent public Nession Pages Collaboration view. The already merged #1834 displays exact PR HEAD and source CI/E2E workflows. This slice covers the **first** Issue→PR edge without inferring that a mention denotes ownership, implementation, or SC Acceptance.

### Trust, security and coverage

- The only relation source is build-time GitHub API `/issues/{N}/timeline?per_page=100`, scoped to *displayed* public Issues, bounded to at most twelve timeline requests. Keep only `event='cross-referenced'` with `source.type='issue'`, same-repository `source.issue.repository.full_name='BestNathan/nession'`, a real `pull_request` object, canonical `source.issue.number`, and a match of GitHub canonical API/HTML path for this PR. Never parse title/body/Issue comments as a trusted edge.
- Project an allowlisted, maximum six **cross-referenced PR numbers** per Issue, deduplicated/deterministic, with canonical `https://github.com/BestNathan/nession/pull/N` links and `relationship='github_cross_reference'`. Avoid inventing an exact HEAD SHA or author/Agent attribution for closed PRs not in the active PR snapshot.
- Retain `available`, `unavailable`, and `truncated` timeline coverage. A missing Timeline or its >=100 results is not proof of zero linked PRs / complete history; explicit unknown source state, do not trust foreign or malformed records.
- Render source-linked PRs in the independent `#/work` Issue rows and ensure browser/mobile/deep-link/regression security tests.
- Absolutely no product `web/` UI/design imports and no privileged runtime or token in the published browser bundle.

### Explicit exclusions

This is an *observed GitHub cross-reference*, not a verified implementation/closing relationship. Issue → exact PR HEAD → CI/E2E proof is only available where the PR is independently in the existing trusted active PR snapshot. Agent run/attempt and Acceptance history remain unlinked until separate canonical evidence is projected. Strong Run Store integrity still depends on #1690.

### Success Criteria

- [ ] SC-01 Build-time source projection uses authenticated same-repository GitHub Issue Timeline cross-references only, with strict PR identity allowlist, bounded deterministic dedup and explicit truncated/unavailable coverage.
- [ ] SC-02 Standalone Work view shows source-linked PR cross-references for Issue rows, with missing/incomplete states clearly marked; never claims ownership, implementation, Agent provenance or SC Pass.
- [ ] SC-03 Deterministic unit/security and browser E2E fixtures reject cross-repo forged PR, non-PR reference, fake URL/ID, duplicates, overflow, unavailable API and malicious HTML while preserving existing Pages/CI/E2E functions.
- [ ] SC-04 Exact-HEAD independent Pages CI, canonical Quality, selected E2E and Acceptance Case Smoke all pass; read-only Agent Acceptance enforced separately through the canonical merge gate.
